title: crepis biennis subsp. maritima
intro: Crepis biennis subsp. maritima, commonly known as sea hawk's beard or sea hawk's beard hawk's beard, is a subspecies of the plant Crepis biennis, belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Crepis biennis subsp. maritima may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant, but its bioactive compounds have shown promise in providing relief from various health conditions.
